node-1.label: Patient developed left facial palsy with lagophthalmos and weak smile (House-Brackman V)

node-2.label: A woman in her 70s presented with impacted cerumen in the right ear, and a practice nurse performed two attempts at bilateral ear irrigation.

node-3.label: Immediately after syringing, the patient reported pain and hearing loss in the left ear, and subsequently developed purulent and blood-stained discharge in that ear.

node-4.label: ENT examination found severe otitis externa with inflammation of the external auditory canal precluding tympanic membrane view; after removal of the wick, a small anteroinferior tympanic membrane perforation was visualized.

node-5.label: Left facial palsy examination showed lagophthalmos, good static tone of the mouth, and weak movement on smiling, graded as House-Brackman V.
